notes: Contract between the Blender pipeline (art_src/blender/) and the Godot client (client/art/model_library.gd).
Conventions for every model: 1 unit = 1 tile, +Y up, front faces +Z, origin at the centre of the footprint on the ground (y = 0).
Static models are exported as GLB with ONE mesh object named 'Mesh' using the kit's atlas material, so the client can reuse the mesh in MultiMeshes. Keep triangle counts as in the source kits.
Buildings are scaled uniformly so their ground bounds fit the footprint times 'fit' (default 0.92). Never stretch non-uniformly.
Characters keep their Skeleton3D and export only the animations listed in 'character_animations'.
Sources are paths relative to source_roots, fetched by scripts/fetch-assets.mjs into .tools/vendor (git-ignored). Only the processed outputs under client/art/ are committed.

naming: A model with one source is client/art/models/<id>.glb (for example keep.glb, farm.glb, stage_a.glb, lectern.glb, carry_wood.glb).

A model with several variants is <id>_<n>.glb, numbered from 0 in manifest order (cottage_0.glb, cottage_1.glb, rock_0.glb .. rock_4.glb, cloud_0.glb, mountain_0.glb). tree_broadleaf, tree_conifer and stump are single files.
Icons are client/art/icons/<id>.png, using the model or character id; resources are resource_food.png, resource_wood.png, resource_stone.png and resource_gold.png.
anchors.json maps each model file stem to {size:[x,y,z], height, door:[x,y,z], top:[x,y,z]} in model space.
Write every output to a temporary file first and rename it into place, so the client never imports a half-written file.
